en: Define agriculture and identify qualifying agriculture expenditure
State what is not qualifying (land, plant and machinery, non-qualifying activity)
Explain eligibility to claim agriculture allowance
Apportion allowances between transmitter and recipient on disposal
Compute agriculture charges and apply the election to spread
ms: Takrifkan pertanian dan kenal pasti perbelanjaan pertanian layak
Nyatakan apa yang tidak layak (tanah, loji dan jentera, aktiviti tidak layak)
Agihkan elaun antara pemindah dan penerima semasa pelupusan
Hitung caj pertanian dan gunakan pilihan untuk menyebar

blocks.en: A person who incurs qualifying agriculture expenditure for an agriculture business is given agriculture allowance, set off against adjusted income from that agriculture business to arrive at statutory income.
blocks.ms: Orang yang menanggung perbelanjaan pertanian layak untuk perniagaan pertanian diberi elaun pertanian, ditolak daripada pendapatan diselaraskan perniagaan pertanian itu untuk mendapat pendapatan berkanun.

blocks.en: Agriculture means any form of cultivation of crops, animal farming, aquaculture, inland fishing and any other agricultural or pastoral pursuit, including reafforestation of timber.
blocks.ms: Pertanian bermaksud sebarang bentuk penanaman tanaman, penternakan haiwan, akuakultur, perikanan darat dan sebarang kegiatan pertanian atau pastoral lain, termasuk penghutanan semula balak.

blocks.en: Slide 4 has no readable text (a figure). Qualifying expenditure and rates below are from PR 1/2016 (paras 5–6; paras 22–23 Schedule 3), which agrees with the lecturer’s worked answers.
blocks.ms: Slaid 4 tiada teks yang boleh dibaca (rajah). Perbelanjaan layak dan kadar di bawah daripada PR 1/2016 (para 5–6; para 22–23 Jadual 3), yang selaras dengan jawapan kerja pensyarah.

en: Cost of acquiring plantation land is not qualifying agriculture expenditure
ms: Kos memperoleh tanah ladang bukan perbelanjaan pertanian layak

en: Machinery used on the farm is claimed under capital allowance for plant and machinery
ms: Jentera di ladang dituntut di bawah elaun modal loji dan jentera

en: Something that is not a farm or plantation, such as a nursery
ms: Sesuatu yang bukan ladang atau estet, seperti taman semaian

blocks.en: Capital expenditure on: (a) clearing and preparing land (including terracing against erosion); (b) planting, but not replanting, of crops on cleared land; (c) construction of a road or bridge on the farm (drains also qualify); (d) construction on the farm of a building used for working the farm, such as an estate office, mill or godown; (e) construction on the farm of a building for the welfare or living accommodation of persons employed on the farm, such as labour quarters, a place of worship or a community hall.
blocks.ms: Perbelanjaan modal ke atas: (a) membersih dan menyediakan tanah (termasuk teres untuk mencegah hakisan); (b) penanaman, tetapi bukan penanaman semula, tanaman di tanah yang telah dibersihkan; (c) pembinaan jalan atau jambatan di ladang (longkang juga layak); (d) pembinaan di ladang bangunan yang digunakan untuk mengusahakan ladang, seperti pejabat estet, kilang (mill) atau gudang; (e) pembinaan di ladang bangunan untuk kebajikan atau tempat tinggal orang yang bekerja di ladang, seperti kuarters buruh, tempat ibadat atau dewan komuniti.

blocks.en: Replanting (replacing the crop with the same product, including reafforestation) is not qualifying agriculture expenditure. PR 1/2016 para 5.8 treats it as a revenue deduction under para 34(6)(d) ITA, which is why the lecturer’s answer shows nil allowance for BioBloom’s replanting; a senior manager’s house ten kilometres from the farm is nil because the building must be constructed on the farm.
blocks.ms: Penanaman semula (menggantikan tanaman dengan produk sama, termasuk penghutanan semula) bukan perbelanjaan pertanian layak. PR 1/2016 para 5.8 menganggapnya potongan hasil di bawah para 34(6)(d) ITA, itulah sebab jawapan pensyarah menunjukkan elaun sifar bagi penanaman semula BioBloom; rumah pengurus kanan sepuluh kilometer dari ladang sifar kerana bangunan mesti dibina di ladang.

blocks.en: At the end of the basis period the person must be the owner of the asset, and the asset must be in use for the business.
blocks.ms: Pada akhir tempoh asas, orang itu mesti pemilik aset, dan aset mesti digunakan untuk perniagaan.

ms: Kilang (mill); bangsal alat ladang; kontena pejabat

blocks.en: PR 1/2016 para 6 confirms the rates: 50% for clearing/preparing land, planting and roads or bridges (para 23 Schedule 3); 20% for welfare/living-accommodation buildings and 10% for any other building (para 22). Mills, estate offices and godowns are ‘other buildings’ at 10%.
blocks.ms: PR 1/2016 para 6 mengesahkan kadar: 50% untuk membersih/menyediakan tanah, penanaman dan jalan atau jambatan (para 23 Jadual 3); 20% untuk bangunan kebajikan/tempat tinggal dan 10% untuk bangunan lain (para 22). Kilang, pejabat estet dan gudang ialah ‘bangunan lain’ pada 10%.

blocks.en: BioBloom Farm: YA2023 = mill 30,000 + clearing 5,000 + planting 4,000 = RM39,000. YA2024 adds bridge 30,000, shed 1,200 and worker accommodation 28,000, so the total is RM98,200 (the mill, clearing and planting continue at the same amounts).
blocks.ms: BioBloom Farm: YA2023 = kilang 30,000 + pembersihan 5,000 + penanaman 4,000 = RM39,000. YA2024 menambah jambatan 30,000, bangsal 1,200 dan penginapan pekerja 28,000, jadi jumlahnya RM98,200 (kilang, pembersihan dan penanaman diteruskan pada amaun sama).

en: Claims agriculture allowance up to the date of disposal in the YA of disposal, if the asset was in use 1 month before disposal; apportioned = days owned before transfer ÷ 365 × allowance
ms: Menuntut elaun pertanian hingga tarikh pelupusan dalam YA pelupusan, jika aset digunakan 1 bulan sebelum pelupusan; agihan = hari dimiliki sebelum pindah ÷ 365 × elaun

en: Entitled to the remaining allowance that the transmitter would have had; must claim in respect of the same YA as the transmitter’s apportioned claim
ms: Berhak ke atas baki elaun yang akan dimiliki pemindah; mesti menuntut bagi YA yang sama dengan tuntutan agihan pemindah

blocks.en: Hijau Sdn Bhd (lecturer’s Q9): 3 of 6 worker quarters (20% of RM40,000 = RM8,000 a year) sold on 30.9.2026, year end 31 Dec. Days from 1 Jan to 30 Sep = 273, so transmitter’s YA2026 allowance on those units = 273/365 × 8,000 = RM5,984, leaving RM2,016 for the buyer if the buyer’s year-end gives the remainder in that YA.
blocks.ms: Hijau Sdn Bhd (S9 pensyarah): 3 daripada 6 kuarters pekerja (20% × RM40,000 = RM8,000 setahun) dijual pada 30.9.2026, akhir tahun 31 Dis. Hari dari 1 Jan hingga 30 Sep = 273, jadi elaun YA2026 pemindah atas unit itu = 273/365 × 8,000 = RM5,984, meninggalkan RM2,016 untuk pembeli jika akhir tahun pembeli memberi baki dalam YA itu.

blocks.en: PR 1/2016 paras 7.1–7.2: the transmitter gets allowances apportioned on a time basis from the start of the basis period to the date of transfer, but none if the asset was not in use for its business within one month before the transfer (or such further period the DG allows). The recipient gets only the other part of the apportioned allowance, in the YA of the basis period in which the transfer took place and later YAs, if it uses the farm (or an adjacent/nearby building) in its own business; the price it paid is disregarded. Apportionment works only when the transfer date falls in the same YA for both parties; if it falls in different YAs, only the transmitter claims, and the remaining balance is disregarded and cannot be claimed by anyone. This explains why the lecturer’s answer shows different buyer figures for different year-ends.
blocks.ms: PR 1/2016 para 7.1–7.2: pemindah mendapat elaun diagihkan mengikut masa dari awal tempoh asas hingga tarikh pindah, tetapi tiada jika aset tidak digunakan untuk perniagaannya dalam sebulan sebelum pindah (atau tempoh lanjut yang dibenarkan KP). Penerima hanya mendapat bahagian lain elaun agihan, dalam YA tempoh asas pemindahan berlaku dan YA seterusnya, jika ia menggunakan ladang (atau bangunan bersebelahan/berhampiran) dalam perniagaannya; harga yang dibayar diketepikan. Pengagihan hanya berfungsi apabila tarikh pindah jatuh dalam YA yang sama bagi kedua-dua pihak; jika jatuh dalam YA berbeza, hanya pemindah menuntut, dan baki diketepikan dan tidak boleh dituntut sesiapa. Ini menerangkan kenapa jawapan pensyarah menunjukkan angka pembeli berbeza bagi akhir tahun berbeza.

title.en: Agriculture Charge and Election to Spread

blocks.en: An agriculture charge arises when an asset on which agriculture allowance has been claimed is disposed of within 5 years from the date the expenditure was incurred (PR 1/2016 Examples 16–17), equal to the total allowances made. If an asset is disposed of after the business has ceased permanently, the disposal is deemed to occur in the basis period in which the business ceased (para 8.3). A government grant or subsidy no longer creates a charge (para 26 deleted from 2013).
blocks.ms: Caj pertanian timbul apabila aset yang telah dituntut elaun pertanian dilupuskan dalam 5 tahun dari tarikh perbelanjaan ditanggung (PR 1/2016 Contoh 16–17), sama dengan jumlah elaun yang telah diberi. Jika aset dilupuskan selepas perniagaan berhenti secara tetap, pelupusan dianggap berlaku dalam tempoh asas perniagaan berhenti (para 8.3). Geran atau subsidi kerajaan tidak lagi mewujudkan caj (para 26 dipadam dari 2013).

blocks.en: Under para 27 Schedule 3 ITA a person may elect to have the charge spread evenly over the years in which the allowances were claimed.
blocks.ms: Di bawah para 27 Jadual 3 ITA seseorang boleh memilih supaya caj disebar sama rata ke atas tahun-tahun elaun dituntut.

en: Add all allowances claimed, including the part-year apportioned allowance in the disposal year
No election: the whole charge falls in the YA of disposal
Election: divide the total by the number of YAs in which allowances were claimed
ms: Tambah semua elaun yang dituntut, termasuk elaun agihan separa tahun dalam tahun pelupusan
Tiada pilihan: seluruh caj jatuh dalam YA pelupusan
Pilihan: bahagikan jumlah dengan bilangan YA elaun dituntut
